jobs.name: rt-parth-clip-native
jobs.prompt:
A NATIVE, authentic Meta ad (portrait 4:5) that must look EXACTLY like a screenshot of a real Instagram Reel / short vertical video — NOT a designed poster or graphic ad. This is a direct-response retargeting ad for a live PTE masterclass. TWO reference images: (1) the trainer's face; (2) the Verbis Edu logo.

FULL-BLEED SCENE: use the MAN in reference 1 EXACTLY — same face, beard, warm expression, navy bandhgala jacket — filling the WHOLE frame (waist-up, fairly close), shot like he is recording a casual selfie-video on his phone in a warm, lived-in study (soft out-of-focus bookshelves, warm lamp light). He looks straight into the lens, talking directly to you, natural and mid-sentence, one hand lightly gesturing. Real phone-video look: natural warm light, slight softness and grain, a little candid imperfection, as if paused mid-clip. Do NOT change his face. There is NO separate text column, NO flat colour panels, NO poster layout — the photo fills everything and all text sits ON TOP of it like video overlays. AVOID: glossy studio polish, slick gradients, floating badges, perfect symmetry, over-saturation.

OVERLAYS (like a real Reel, sitting on top of the video):
- TOP-LEFT: a small casual caption sticker — a dark rounded translucent label with white text: 'Stuck at 65-79? Watch this 👇'
- LOWER-CENTRE: big BOLD auto-caption subtitles in the TikTok / Instagram style — white text with a dark outline for readability, two short stacked lines, with the key word highlighted in bright gold: 'PTE doesn't score your English. It scores your FORMAT.' — put the word 'FORMAT' in bright gold, the rest white.
- Along the very BOTTOM: a slim semi-transparent dark bar with small clean white text: 'LIVE · 4-HR PTE MASTERCLASS · SAT 11 JULY · ₹589 · Book my seat'.

Reproduce the VERBIS EDU logo (reference 2) SMALL in the TOP-RIGHT corner, fully visible, not cropped, with a clear margin from the edges.

Overall it must look like a genuine paused Reel a student would scroll past — casual, real, video-native — NOT an advertisement poster. All added text crisp and correctly spelled.
